description: Department of Local Government - North Central Province - Details of New Vice Chairman of Thirappane Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice announces the election and declaration of a new Vice Chairman for a local authority (Thirappane Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with electoral processes and candidate declarations at the local government level, which falls squarely under the Elections category (Type 7) for electoral processes and related matters.
